[{"insert":"Seated DB Press

The seated DB press takes your legs out of it and makes your shoulders do all the work overhead. Sitting also stops your lower back from helping, so the press is more honest. Keep the dumbbells traveling straight up and brace your core on every rep. Pair it with push ups, which will feel harder than usual since your shoulders are already tired.
"}]
